answer_1.quote: We propose CODEFUSION, the first diffusionbased NL-to-code model ... We evaluate CODEFUSION on NL-to-code for three different languages: Python, Bash, and conditional formatting rules in Microsoft Excel.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate Bash using the template match metric ... We evaluate Python using CodeBERTScore ... We evaluate CF using execution match ... To evaluate generation diversity, we measure (1) count of distinct token n-grams ... (2) summary statistics over pairwise similarities of CodeBERT encodings, (3) summary statistics over pairwise string edit distances.
